name: Blessura
description: Blessura is Lazarus's ultra-premium bliss compound, available only through Tier 5 wellness consultants — a multi-pathway neurological optimizer that achieves total hedonic saturation through simultaneous engagement of every known reward circuit, wrapped in a dissociative warmth that removes suffering, urgency, and want. Users describe it as the feeling that everything is, and has always been, exactly as it should be.
effects: Total hedonic saturation — every reward circuit engaged simultaneously
Complete cessation of suffering, anxiety, grief, and want
Profound sense of universal rightness and acceptance
Gentle euphoric warmth without excitement or stimulation
Users feel perfectly loved, perfectly safe, perfectly complete
side_effects: Absolute anhedonia upon cessation — baseline life registers as suffering by contrast
The drug produces no motivation to seek another dose — which is the most dangerous thing about it, because users simply stop engaging with life until they use again
Long-term: atrophy of natural reward processing
Ocular delivery causes mild conjunctival irritation at low doses; chronic use causes visible blood vessel changes
Extreme psychological dependency; withdrawal classified as an existential crisis event
street_price: Φ2,400 per dose (no street equivalent exists)
cultural_context: Blessura is the drug the Spire doesn't discuss publicly. It's prescribed as 'grief management' and 'executive stress optimization' by Lazarus's private wellness arm. In practice, it's what Tier 5 residents use when they've achieved everything and feel nothing. The irony of the wealthiest people in GLMZ chemically simulating the contentment they cannot naturally access is not lost on anyone who knows about it — which is very few people. Lazarus ensures that.
story_hooks: A Tier 5 executive under Blessura maintenance signed off on a city-wide infrastructure decision that will devastate Tier 1 and 2 residents — they cannot be reached emotionally and won't be off the drug for weeks; someone needs to find a way to break through or break the supply

A Lazarus Atelier wellness consultant has gone missing after threatening to expose what percentage of GLMZ's governing council is on Blessura maintenance — and what decisions were made while they were dosed
A small amount of Blessura has appeared on the Shelf in counterfeit form, and the people who took it have stopped eating, stopped moving, and are smiling
